summary.en-US: Remove SponsorBlock segments from local video and audio files

description.en-US:
SBSkip is a SponsorBlock-powered media cleaner for Android.

Select a local video or audio file, provide the corresponding YouTube URL,
and SBSkip will retrieve SponsorBlock segments and create a cleaned copy
with sponsor segments removed.

Features:

* SponsorBlock integration
* Local video and audio file processing
* Background processing with WorkManager
* Material 3 user interface
* Persistent settings with DataStore
* FFmpeg-based media trimming
* No account required

SBSkip processes media locally on the device. No YouTube account or API key
is required.

summary.en-US: Automatically adjust contact ringtones based on call activity

description.en-US:
Smart Ringtone automatically changes contact-specific ringtones based on your call history.

The app tracks missed, rejected, incoming, and outgoing calls, assigning a score to each contact. As a contact's score changes, Smart Ringtone can automatically update their ringtone, helping important callers stand out.

Features:

* Automatic contact ringtone assignment
* Configurable ringtone priority levels
* Call score tracking based on call activity
* Support for missed, rejected, incoming, and outgoing calls
* Contact score management and reset controls
* Local processing with no account required
* No internet connection required

Smart Ringtone uses Android's built-in contact ringtone functionality and performs all processing on the device. No call logs, contacts, or personal information are transmitted to external servers.

Required permissions:

* Contacts - to read and update contact ringtone settings
* Phone State - to detect call state changes
* Call Logs - to process call activity and update scores
